method: Assistant visual review of 12 sampled frames across each clip, plus denser sequences for ambiguous exchanges and rollouts. These are review labels, not official statistics.

definitions.run: Observed rushing action, including backward pitches and QB carries.
definitions.pass: Forward passes and identifiable passing dropbacks ending in sacks.
definitions.uncertain: Insufficient visible action to distinguish run from pass.
definitions.no_play: Scoreboard, pre-snap-only or stopped clips without sustained action; not an official penalty ruling.
